Sources/MetronomeCore/Rhythm.notes: Rhythm engine with subdivisions (triplets, 6-tuplets, shuffle) and pattern timing

Sources/MetronomeCore/Audio.notes: AVAudioEngine audio synthesizer, multi-timbre click generator, and reference pitch drone
